<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Stat } from "../blocks/stats-band.types";

  export type StatFigureProps = {
    stat: Stat;
    item?: "plain" | "card" | "icon";
    align?: "start" | "center";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import StatTile from "../components/stat-tile.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let { stat, item = "plain", align = "center" }: StatFigureProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((item as string) === "card")}
  <StatTile label={stat.label} value={stat.value} icon={stat.icon} hint={stat.hint} />
{:else}
  <Stack
    gap="6"
    align={(((align as string) === "center") ? "center" : "start")}
    class={cn((((align as string) === "center") ? "text-center" : ""), defaults.stats.column)}
    data-testid="item"
  >
    {#if ((item as string) === "icon")}
      <LucideIcon name={stat.icon} size={24} />
    {/if}
    <Stack gap="2" align={(((align as string) === "center") ? "center" : "start")}>
      <Text size="5xl" weight="medium" class={cn("flex items-center", defaults.stats.figure)}>
        {stat.value}
      </Text>
      <Text size="sm" weight="semibold" class="leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
        {stat.label}
      </Text>
    </Stack>
